## Walkthrough

This pull request updates test vector references and paths across two files. The `.github/scripts/load-test-ref.sh` file has its REF commit hash updated to point to a new test vectors reference, which is then exported as TEST_VECTORS_REF to the GitHub environment. Simultaneously, `bin/test-runner/w3f-070.ts` updates its test vector base path from a hyphenated format to an underscore format and removes the "trie/" directory from its ignore list, allowing that directory to be included in testing.
